question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Raze
solution: The correct answer is '**Build**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Raze**' is '**Build**'. • **Raze**: to completely destroy a building, town, etc. so that nothing is left. [(भवन, शहर आदि) पूर्णतः नष्‍ट कर देना; ध्‍वस्‍त करना] • *Example: The building was **razed** to the ground.* • **Build**: to make something by putting pieces, materials, etc. together. (बनाना, निर्माण करना) • *Example: They’ve **built** a new bridge across the river.* **Correct Answer:__** *Build.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Comfort**: the state of having everything your body needs, or of having a pleasant life. (शारीरिक आवश्‍यकताओं की पूर्ति की स्थिति; आराम, आनंद, सुख-सुविधा) • **Ease**: a lack of difficulty. (आसानी, सरलता, सुगमता) • **Ruin**: to damage something so badly that it loses all its value, pleasure, etc. [किसी चीज़ को तबाह कर देना, बरबाद कर देना (कि वह बिलकुल बेकार हो जाए)] 3b:Tc41, The correct answer is '**React**'.
